authDevicePrompt: Open the browser page and enter this code: {{code}}
playbackAuthExplanation: Twitch does not allow third-party app tokens to authenticate its private playback request. Paste the auth-token from your own Twitch website session to associate Streamlink playback with this account.
playbackAuthWarning: This credential grants access to your Twitch account. The app stores it in the OS credential manager and also writes it to Streamlink's local config.twitch file because Streamlink must read it. Do not share that file or this token.
tauriRequiredBody: You opened the Vite web UI in a browser. Streamlink Twitch GUI needs the Tauri window so login, settings storage, and Streamlink launch work.
updateAvailableBody: Download now and relaunch into the new version.
updateInstalling: Installing — the installer opens and the app restarts.
updateFailed: Update failed. You can retry from About.
